summary: Immatics N.V. furnished a Form 6-K containing an interim report for Q1 2026 and a press release with financial results and a business update. This is a routine periodic report filed by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16; it does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. Accordingly, the filing is not a special situation.
